## Merging and data scaling
```{r} 
Combined_hpa <- merge(obj_0_hpa_B_processed, y = c(obj_1_hpa_B_processed, obj_3_hpa_A_processed, obj_12_hpa_A_processed), project = "Combined_hpa")
all.genes <- rownames(Combined_hpa)
Combined_hpa <- NormalizeData(Combined_hpa)
Combined_hpa <- FindVariableFeatures(Combined_hpa)
Combined_hpa <- ScaleData(Combined_hpa, features = all.genes)
```


## PCA UMAP
```{r PCA}
Combined_hpa <- RunPCA(Combined_hpa)
ElbowPlot(Combined_hpa, ndims = 50)
Combined_hpa <- FindNeighbors(Combined_hpa, dims = 1:30 , reduction = "pca")
Combined_hpa <- FindClusters(Combined_hpa, resolution = 2, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")
Combined_hpa <- RunUMAP(Combined_hpa, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")
DimPlot(Combined_hpa, reduction = "umap.unintegrated" )
```

## Integration 
Error resolved by scaling after merging after combining layers
```{r integration, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width = 16.2}
Combined_hpa
saveRDS(Combined_hpa, file = "/Users/ladislavbucek/Desktop/UK/Mgr./labgenexp/20200122_10x_frog_tail_regeneration/20220817_new_genome/data/processed/Combined_hpa.rds")
Combined_hpa <- IntegrateLayers(object = Combined_hpa, method = CCAIntegration, orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.cca", verbose = FALSE)

#rejoin layers 
Combined_hpa[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(Combined_hpa[["RNA"]])

Combined_hpa <- FindNeighbors(Combined_hpa, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:30)
Combined_hpa <- FindClusters(Combined_hpa, resolution = 1)
Combined_hpa <- RunUMAP(Combined_hpa, dims = 1:30, reduction = "integrated.cca")

# Visualization

# Define a distinct color palette for clusters
cluster_colors <- Polychrome::createPalette(33, c("#ff0000", "#00ff00", "#0000ff"))
# Ensure cluster_colors is a named vector
cluster_labels <- as.character(0:32)  # Creates labels from "0" to "31"
names(cluster_colors) <- cluster_labels  # Assign each color to a cluster label

# Generate the UMAP plot with custom colors
DimPlot(Combined_hpa, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
    theme_minimal() +
    ggtitle("UMAP with Distinguishable Colors for 32 Clusters")

DimPlot(Combined_hpa, reduction = "umap", split.by = "hpa") + 
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors)

saveRDS(Combined_hpa, file = "/Users/ladislavbucek/Desktop/UK/Mgr./labgenexp/20200122_10x_frog_tail_regeneration/20220817_new_genome/data/processed/Combined_hpa_integrated_with_markers.rds")

```

Resources for annotation
- [Characterization of regeneration initiating cells during Xenopus laevis tail regeneration](https://genomebiology.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s13059-024-03396-3)

markers$notochord <- c("plod2.L","col9a1-b")
markers$ROCs <- c("fgf10.L","lef1.S")

# Convert the data into a list of gene sets

UCell plots visualisation
```{r Ucell plots, fig.height=6, fig.width = 10}
# Define marker groups as before
marker_groups <- list(
    "Basal Epidermis" = c("tp63.L", "tp63.S"),
    "Epidermis" = c("fgfbp2.L", "nptx1.L"),
    "Erythrocytes" = c("epor.L", "hba1.S"),
    "Goblet Cells" = c("itln1.L", "anxa9.L"),
    "Ionocytes" = c("atp6v0d2.L", "foxi1.L"),
    "MCCs" = c("iqcd.L", "tekt3.L"),
    "Melanocytes" = c("sox10.L", "slc45a2.L"),
    "Muscle Cells" = c("eno3.L", "des.1.L"),
    "Neuronal Cells" = c("sncb.L", "elavl4.L"),
    "Notochord" = c("plod2.L", "col9a1-b"),
    "ROCs" = c("fgf10.L", "lef1.S"),
    "Somites and Other" = c("pax9.L", "zic1.L"),
    "SSCs" = c("foxa1.L", "kcna4.S")
)

# Calculate the combined UCell score for each marker group
for (group_name in names(marker_groups)) {
    markers <- marker_groups[[group_name]]
    Combined_hpa[[paste0(group_name, "_combined")]] <- rowMeans(
        FetchData(Combined_hpa, vars = markers),
        na.rm = TRUE
    )
}

# Create a list of the new combined feature names
combined_features <- paste0(names(marker_groups), "_combined")

# Plot the combined UCell scores for each group
for (combined_feature in combined_features) {
    plot <- VlnPlot(Combined_hpa, features = combined_feature, group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0.5) +
        ggtitle(paste("Combined UCell Score for", gsub("_combined", "", combined_feature))) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
    
    print(plot)  # Print each plot
}

```
